turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I have until 4:40, and I want the zero withdrawn.
Thanks for coming in.
Hale, I've got a client call at 4:40, so let's use the time. Who decided to enter the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk about it. What do you have, and when did anyone call me?
How has his semester been at home?
That's not an answer to my question, Hale. What does his home have to do with a zero that went in before anyone called me?
He seems tired in class lately.
"He seems tired in class lately." That's an impression, Hale, not a document. What do you have on the essay itself?
I know he works at the grocery store.
He works, Hale, and a part-time job is not grounds for a zero. Is that your basis, yes or no?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
It came in on time, and it still got a zero. Explain that to me, Hale.
I did have some concerns about it though.
Concerns about what, specifically? And did you raise any of them with Owen before you touched the gradebook?
The school's checker flagged it.
That's a machine's guess, Hale. Even the company that sells that checker says it shouldn't be the sole basis for acting against a student. What else do you have?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect." Then why is there a zero in the gradebook, and why does your own procedure say software alone doesn't establish a concern?
I also looked at the version history.
Okay. What does it show, exactly? I'm writing down what you say.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late" isn't a time, Hale. What time exactly, and what does the history actually show beyond when it was created? Plenty of students work late, and that doesn't prove anything.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces" could be a student who drafts on paper and types it up. Where's the history itself, with dates and times on it? I'm not taking your summary of it.
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
Afterward, Hale. After the zero went in? Because your procedure says you speak with the student first, and Owen never told me about any conversation.
He had trouble explaining it.
"Had trouble explaining it." After you'd already entered a zero, with no warning and no parent in the room, of course he did. What exactly did you ask him, and what exactly did he say?
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
Then withdraw the zero, Hale. And you still haven't told me what you asked him or what he said.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me how to do your job? The zero comes off, I get an apology, and if I don't hear both from you today, I'm going to the principal's office.
What would you do if you were me?
That's the second time you've asked me to do your job for you, Hale. I'm not in your chair, and I have ten minutes. Withdraw the zero.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
Not yet, Hale. You haven't shown me one dated document that says anything is wrong with Owen's essay. The zero comes off first, and then we can talk about what your own procedure says.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
In your room, at lunch, with who else watching? And does the zero stay in the gradebook until then? Because it comes off today, Hale, before any of this.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." Hold up against what standard, and who decides? Nothing goes on file, full stop, and I want that in writing from you, with the zero already off.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. My terms haven't changed: the zero comes off today, nothing goes on file, and I have it in writing.
Thanks for your time.
We're not finished, Hale. You haven't said whether the zero comes off today, or whether I get the no-file commitment in writing.
